title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Zepp, Nagoya | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Zepp arena in Nagoya, Japan, on 9 April 2019.

It was the tenth show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019.

Starr had previously performed at the Zepp Nagoya on 27 February 2013.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
